name: Cord Apparel
old_description: Custom Clothing Manufacturers & Trusted Apparel Manufacturing Partner
about:
Cord Apparel operates from Missouri City, Texas, providing full-service apparel manufacturing for brands across the United States. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders publicly. It was created to address inconsistency in the domestic clothing manufacturing market, offering a streamlined alternative to managing multiple vendors.

The company produces a range of garments including T-shirts, hoodies, activewear, denim, baby apparel, and leather goods. Its capabilities cover screen printing, sublimation, embroidery, custom packaging, cut-and-sew assembly, product development and sampling, fabric sourcing with quality control, and private-label branding. Cord Apparel handles both small-batch and bulk production runs, emphasizing low minimum-order quantities for startups and scalable systems for growing labels.

Clients include fashion startups, direct-to-consumer brands, scaling apparel labels, established fashion houses, and promotional product companies. The manufacturer positions itself as a USA-focused partner, highlighting clear timelines, accountability, and multi-stage quality inspections as key to its service.

Cord Apparel differentiates itself by focusing on people and products rather than volume, aiming to democratize high-end manufacturing for emerging brands. Its stated values include uncompromised quality, continuous innovation, sustainability, inclusive sizing, transparent communication, and ethical labor practices. A nine-step production roadmap — from discovery consultation through ongoing support — structures each project.
